sn44.8:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.8:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.8:1.3: kinnu kho bho gotama, sassato lokoti?
sn44.8:1.4: avyākataṃ kho etaṃ vaccha mayā: “sassato loko”ti …pe…
sn44.8:1.5: kimpana bho gotama, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.8:1.7: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.8:2.1: ko nu kho bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:2.3: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā?”
sn44.8:2.4: ko pana bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena bhoto gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:2.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti?
sn44.8:3.1: aññatitthiyā kho vaccha, paribbājakā rūpaṃ attato samanupassanti, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
sn44.8:3.5: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassanti, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:3.6: tasmā aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:3.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā.
sn44.8:3.9: tathāgato ca kho vaccha, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:3.13: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:3.14: tasmā tathāgatassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:3.16: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti.
sn44.8:4.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako uṭṭhāyāsanā yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.8:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.8:4.3: kinnu kho bho moggallāna, sassato lokoti?
sn44.8:4.4: avyākataṃ kho etaṃ vaccha, bhagavatā, “sassato loko”ti …pe…
sn44.8:4.5: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.8:4.7: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.8:5.1: ko nu kho bho moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:5.3: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”vā?
sn44.8:5.4: ko pana bho moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:5.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti?
sn44.8:6.1: aññatitthiyā kho vaccha, paribbājakā rūpaṃ attato samanupassanti, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:6.5: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassanti, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:6.6: tasmā aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:6.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā.”
sn44.8:6.9: tathāgato ca kho vaccha, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:6.13: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
sn44.8:6.14: tasmā tathāgatassa evaṃ phuṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.8:6.15: “sassato lokotipi, asassato lokotipi, antavā lokotipi, anantavā lokotipi, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrantipi, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīrantipi, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti.
sn44.8:7.1: acchariyaṃ bho moggallāna, abbhutaṃ bho moggallāna,
sn44.8:7.2: yatra hi nāma satthu ca sāvakassa ca atthenattho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ.
sn44.8:7.3: idānāhaṃ bho moggallāna, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ āpucchiṃ.
sn44.8:7.4: samaṇopi me gotamo etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi etamatthaṃ vyākāsi, seyyathāpi bhavaṃ moggallāno.
sn44.8:7.5: acchariyaṃ bho moggallāna, abbhutaṃ bho moggallāna,
sn44.8:7.6: yatra hi nāma satthu ca sāvakassa ca atthenattho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidaṃ aggapadasminti.
